name: starmade-blockeditor
description: Visual block editor for StarMade — 3D preview with texture atlas mapping

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=server && npm run build --workspace=client
scripts.preview: npm run build && npm run start
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=server && npm run test --workspace=client
scripts.coverage: npm run coverage --workspace=server && npm run coverage --workspace=client && node scripts/check-coverage.mjs
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=server && npm run typecheck --workspace=client
scripts.validate: npm run vendor:check && npm run docs:check && npm run typecheck && npm run test:tooling && npm run coverage && npm run build
scripts.release:check: npm run validate && npm run test:browser
